---
title: "Installation"
---

## Install from GitHub

`neuroboros` is under active development, so install the latest version directly from the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/neuroboros/neuroboros):

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/neuroboros/neuroboros.git
```

Run the same command again to upgrade to the latest version.
It depends on NumPy, SciPy, nibabel, pandas, matplotlib, joblib, Pillow, and requests, which pip installs automatically.
Python 3.8 or newer is recommended.

## Optional packages

Hyperalignment analyses use the separate [`hyperalignment`](https://github.com/feilong/hyperalignment) package, also installed from GitHub:

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/feilong/hyperalignment.git
```

## Check the installation

```python
import neuroboros as nb

print(nb.__version__)
```

## Where data is stored

Brain templates and datasets are downloaded on first use and cached under `~/.neuroboros-data`.
To use a different location, for example a shared directory on a cluster, set the `NEUROBOROS_DATA_DIR` environment variable before starting Python:

```bash
export NEUROBOROS_DATA_DIR=/path/to/neuroboros-data
```

Downloads work over plain HTTPS and need no extra software.
Using DataLad for faster or partial downloads, and pointing `neuroboros` at local copies of datasets, are covered in a later guide page.
